name: Mechanical Jumper — JP2
description: Cluster of 8 legacy mechanical jumper parts associated with the JP2 package family and related footprints.
selection_hints: Select based on the required footprint variant such as JP2, JP2-CLOSED, JP2-C1C, or JP2-D1C.
Verify footprint geometry and pad layout against design requirements prior to board layout.
Evaluate Tier C legacy distributor records for project suitability.
avoid_when: The board layout requires a package family other than JP2.
Unverified Tier C legacy parts are not accepted for the design.
A defined mounting method is strictly required instead of unknown mounting.
